title: Kanbus client and board UI in Babulus studio
description: Port KanbusClient (Prospectus src/client.ts: X-Operation-Id idempotency, If-Match revisions, 409 on stale) and render boards with the shared @kanbus/ui package. Server-side writes (e.g. from workers) use the Lambda invoke path like Prospectus intake (server/canonical-invoke.ts), not the browser. Depends on the store infrastructure task.
